messages:
anna: opened a docs PR to update Console observability examples -> switch from X-Cloud-Trace-Context to W3C traceparent, and refresh the cost/latency widget keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489 Need quick eyes on snippets + a broken dashboard link.

docs-bot: Pull request opened by @anna — automated checks: linkcheck FAILED (1 outdated dashboard URL), lint: code-block line-length.

matt: noted. backend renamed metric keys recently: use `token_unit_cost` (not `token_cost`) and grouping key is `api_route`. Also dashboard schema moved to /dashboards/v2/schema so update any JSON examples.

rachel: I can patch SDK snippets. Prefer showing per-request header injection so users can attach a trace to a single call. Example Python snippet I'll add: `from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.chat.create(model="redwood-chat-7b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}], headers={"traceparent":"00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01"})
print(resp.text)`

infra-bot: note: hosted traces default sampling is 1%. If customers need higher sampling, open an infra ticket. Also ensure proxies don't strip `traceparent`.

matt: tiny nit — in prose call out `token_unit_cost` when explaining billing. For the widget, include this minimal JSON fragment: `{
  "widget_type":"cost_breakdown",
  "metrics":["token_unit_cost","latency_ms_p50","latency_ms_p95"],
  "group_by":["api_route","model"],
  "time_range":"7d"
}`

rachel: patched the TS/Python snippets, fixed the dashboard v2 URL, and shortened the long line. Force-pushed.

docs-bot: Linkcheck passed. Lint passed. Build preview ready.

anna: excellent — action items: (1) rachel confirm snippets include sampling/troubleshooting note (2) matt add short migration checklist (old->new keys) at top. I'll merge after CI green. ETA today. :rocket:
